metadata.description: Abrar118's Claude Code mods and skills

plugins.name: agent-panel
plugins.description: Activity side pane: tasks, background jobs, agents, assumptions, file tree; progress band above the prompt.

plugins.name: assumption-log
plugins.description: Claude logs each assumption it makes; mark them right or wrong in a side pane.

plugins.name: prompt-deck
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: usage, cache countdown, git health, next-prompt suggestion; /limits pane.

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: Queue prompt ideas while Claude works (/add-queue), send or discard them later.

plugins.name: turn-meter
plugins.description: Duration, tool calls and cost for each turn; shown in the prompt-deck band.

plugins.name: limit-guard
plugins.description: Warns as the 5-hour limit fills; asks before subagents when nearly spent.

plugins.name: safety-guard
plugins.description: Asks before force pushes, pushes and merges into main, PR merges, rm -rf, hard resets, DROP statements and .env writes.

plugins.name: push-preflight
plugins.description: Runs the repo's format, lint and typecheck scripts before git push.

plugins.name: format-on-edit
plugins.description: Runs the project's own formatter on each edited file.

plugins.name: venv-auto
plugins.description: Activates the nearest .venv for python, pip, pytest and jupyter, in Bash and PowerShell.

plugins.name: debug-on-paste
plugins.description: Pasted error or stack trace? Tells Claude to debug systematically.

plugins.name: verify-outside-feedback
plugins.description: Skill: check each claim in pasted feedback with evidence before agreeing.
